\u043e\u0431\u043d\u043e\u0432\u043b\u044f\u0435\u0442\u0441\u044f Task System.\n\n\u0410\u0440\u0445\u0438\u0442\u0435\u043a\u0442\u0443\u0440\u0430 \u0434\u043e\u043b\u0436\u043d\u0430 \u043f\u043e\u0437\u0432\u043e\u043b\u044f\u0442\u044c \u043f\u043e\u0437\u0436\u0435 \u0434\u043e\u0431\u0430\u0432\u043b\u044f\u0442\u044c:\n- \u0434\u0440\u0443\u0433\u0438\u0435 \u043f\u0440\u043e\u0434\u0443\u043a\u0442\u044b;\n- \u0440\u0430\u0437\u043d\u044b\u0435 \u0434\u043e\u0441\u0442\u0430\u0432\u043a\u0438;\n- \u0441\u044e\u0436\u0435\u0442\u043d\u044b\u0435 \u0441\u043e\u0431\u044b\u0442\u0438\u044f.\n\n==================================================\n23. FIRST PERSON CAMERA SYSTEM\n==================================================\n\n\u0421\u043e\u0437\u0434\u0430\u0442\u044c \u043e\u0442\u0434\u0435\u043b\u044c\u043d\u044b\u0439 CameraController.\n\n\u0413\u043b\u0430\u0432\u043d\u0430\u044f \u0446\u0435\u043b\u044c:\n\n\u0421\u0434\u0435\u043b\u0430\u0442\u044c \u043d\u0430\u0441\u0442\u043e\u044f\u0449\u0438\u0439 \u0445\u043e\u0440\u0440\u043e\u0440 first person.\n\n\u041a\u0430\u043c\u0435\u0440\u0430 \u041d\u0415 \u0434\u043e\u043b\u0436\u043d\u0430 \u0431\u044b\u0442\u044c \u043e\u0431\u044b\u0447\u043d\u043e\u0439 Roblox \u043a\u0430\u043c\u0435\u0440\u043e\u0439.\n\n\u041e\u043d\u0430 \u0434\u043e\u043b\u0436\u043d\u0430 \u0443\u0447\u0438\u0442\u044b\u0432\u0430\u0442\u044c:\n\n- \u0430\u043d\u0438\u043c\u0430\u0446\u0438\u0438 \u043f\u0435\u0440\u0441\u043e\u043d\u0430\u0436\u0430;\n- \u0434\u0432\u0438\u0436\u0435\u043d\u0438\u0435 \u0433\u043e\u043b\u043e\u0432\u044b;\n- \u043d\u0430\u043a\u043b\u043e\u043d\u044b \u0442\u0435\u043b\u0430;\n- \u043f\u043e\u0432\u043e\u0440\u043e\u0442\u044b \u0448\u0435\u0438.\n\n\u041a\u043e\u0433\u0434\u0430 \u0438\u0433\u0440\u043e\u043a \u0445\u043e\u0434\u0438\u0442:\n\n\u043a\u0430\u043c\u0435\u0440\u0430 \u0434\u043e\u043b\u0436\u043d\u0430 \u0434\u0432\u0438\u0433\u0430\u0442\u044c\u0441\u044f \u0432\u043c\u0435\u0441\u0442\u0435 \u0441 \u0433\u043e\u043b\u043e\u0432\u043e\u0439 \u043f\u0435\u0440\u0441\u043e\u043d\u0430\u0436\u0430.\n\n\u041d\u0430\u043f\u0440\u0438\u043c\u0435\u0440:\n\n- \u043f\u0440\u0438 \u0448\u0430\u0433\u0435 \u0432\u043d\u0438\u0437 \u043a\u0430\u043c\u0435\u0440\u0430 \u0441\u043b\u0435\u0433\u043a\u0430 \u043e\u043f\u0443\u0441\u043a\u0430\u0435\u0442\u0441\u044f;\n- \u043f\u0440\u0438 \u043f\u043e\u0432\u043e\u0440\u043e\u0442\u0435 \u0433\u043e\u043b\u043e\u0432\u044b \u043a\u0430\u043c\u0435\u0440\u0430 \u043f\u043e\u0432\u0442\u043e\u0440\u044f\u0435\u0442 \u0434\u0432\u0438\u0436\u0435\u043d\u0438\u0435;\n- \u043f\u0440\u0438 \u0431\u0435\u0433\u0435 \u043f\u043e\u044f\u0432\u043b\u044f\u0435\u0442\u0441\u044f \u0435\u0441\u0442\u0435\u0441\u0442\u0432\u0435\u043d\u043d\u0430\u044f \u0442\u0440\u044f\u0441\u043a\u0430;\n- \u043f\u0440\u0438 \u0440\u0435\u0437\u043a\u043e\u0439 \u043e\u0441\u0442\u0430\u043d\u043e\u0432\u043a\u0435 \u0435\u0441\u0442\u044c \u0438\u043d\u0435\u0440\u0446\u0438\u044f.\n\n\u041d\u0435 \u0434\u0435\u043b\u0430\u0442\u044c:\n- \u043f\u043e\u0441\u0442\u043e\u044f\u043d\u043d\u0443\u044e \u0440\u043e\u0432\u043d\u0443\u044e \u043a\u0430\u043c\u0435\u0440\u0443 \u0438\u0437 \u0446\u0435\u043d\u0442\u0440\u0430 HumanoidRootPart.\n\n==================================================\n24. PLAYER RIG CAMERA PREPARATION\n==================================================\n\n\u0421\u043e\u0437\u0434\u0430\u0442\u044c \u043e\u0442\u0434\u0435\u043b\u044c\u043d\u044b\u0439 Config:\n\nPlayerAnimationConfig\n\n\u0412 \u043d\u0451\u043c \u0434\u043e\u043b\u0436\u043d\u044b \u0431\u044b\u0442\u044c \u043f\u043e\u043b\u044f:\n\nIdleAnimation\nWalkAnimation\nRunAnimation\nJumpAnimation\n\n\u041f\u0440\u044b\u0436\u043a\u0438 \u0434\u043e\u043b\u0436\u043d\u044b \u0431\u044b\u0442\u044c \u043e\u0442\u043a\u043b\u044e\u0447\u0435\u043d\u044b.\n\n\u0418\u0441\u043f\u043e\u043b\u044c\u0437\u043e\u0432\u0430\u0442\u044c R6 \u043f\u0435\u0440\u0441\u043e\u043d\u0430\u0436\u0430.\n\n\u041f\u043e\u0434\u0433\u043e\u0442\u043e\u0432\u0438\u0442\u044c \u0441\u0438\u0441\u0442\u0435\u043c\u0443 \u0442\u0430\u043a, \u0447\u0442\u043e\u0431\u044b \u043f\u043e\u0437\u0436\u0435 \u043c\u043e\u0436\u043d\u043e \u0431\u044b\u043b\u043e \u043f\u0440\u043e\u0441\u0442\u043e \u0432\u0441\u0442\u0430\u0432\u0438\u0442\u044c ID \u0430\u043d\u0438\u043c\u0430\u0446\u0438\u0439.\n\n==================================================\n25. FIRST PERSON BODY HIDING\n==================================================\n\n\u0412 \u043f\u0435\u0440\u0432\u043e\u043c \u043b\u0438\u0446\u0435 \u0438\u0433\u0440\u043e\u043a \u041d\u0415 \u0434\u043e\u043b\u0436\u0435\u043d \u0432\u0438\u0434\u0435\u0442\u044c \u0441\u043e\u0431\u0441\u0442\u0432\u0435\u043d\u043d\u0443\u044e \u0433\u043e\u043b\u043e\u0432\u0443.\n\n\u0421\u043a\u0440\u044b\u0432\u0430\u0442\u044c:\n\n- Head;\n- \u043b\u0438\u0446\u043e;\n- \u0432\u043e\u043b\u043e\u0441\u044b;\n- \u0430\u043a\u0441\u0435\u0441\u0441\u0443\u0430\u0440\u044b \u043d\u0430 \u0433\u043e\u043b\u043e\u0432\u0435.\n\n\u041d\u043e \u043e\u0441\u0442\u0430\u043b\u044c\u043d\u044b\u0435 \u0447\u0430\u0441\u0442\u0438 \u0442\u0435\u043b\u0430 \u043c\u043e\u0433\u0443\u0442 \u043e\u0441\u0442\u0430\u0432\u0430\u0442\u044c\u0441\u044f \u0432\u0438\u0434\u0438\u043c\u044b\u043c\u0438:\n\n- \u0440\u0443\u043a\u0438;\n- \u0442\u0435\u043b\u043e;\n- \u043f\u0440\u0435\u0434\u043c\u0435\u0442\u044b \u0432 \u0440\u0443\u043a\u0430\u0445.\n\n\u0421\u0434\u0435\u043b\u0430\u0442\u044c \u044d\u0442\u043e \u043a\u043e\u0440\u0440\u0435\u043a\u0442\u043d\u043e \u0447\u0435\u0440\u0435\u0437 LocalScript.\n\n\u0414\u0440\u0443\u0433\u0438\u0435 \u0438\u0433\u0440\u043e\u043a\u0438 \u0434\u043e\u043b\u0436\u043d\u044b \u0432\u0438\u0434\u0435\u0442\u044c \u043f\u0435\u0440\u0441\u043e\u043d\u0430\u0436\u0430 \u043f\u043e\u043b\u043d\u043e\u0441\u0442\u044c\u044e.\n\n==================================================\n26. PLAYER ANIMATION SYSTEM\n==================================================\n\n\u0421\u043e\u0437\u0434\u0430\u0442\u044c \u043e\u0442\u0434\u0435\u043b\u044c\u043d\u044b\u0439 AnimationController.\n\n\u041e\u043d \u0434\u043e\u043b\u0436\u0435\u043d:\n\n- \u0437\u0430\u0433\u0440\u0443\u0436\u0430\u0442\u044c \u0430\u043d\u0438\u043c\u0430\u0446\u0438\u0438 \u0438\u0437 Config;\n- \u0443\u043f\u0440\u0430\u0432\u043b\u044f\u0442\u044c Idle/Walk/Run;\n- \u0438\u043c\u0435\u0442\u044c \u043f\u0440\u0438\u043e\u0440\u0438\u0442\u0435\u0442\u044b;\n- \u043d\u0435 \u043b\u043e\u043c\u0430\u0442\u044c \u0441\u0442\u0430\u043d\u0434\u0430\u0440\u0442\u043d\u044b\u0435 Roblox \u0430\u043d\u0438\u043c\u0430\u0446\u0438\u0438.\n\n\u0417\u0430\u043f\u0440\u0435\u0442\u0438\u0442\u044c:\n\n- Jump animation;\n- \u0441\u0442\u0430\u043d\u0434\u0430\u0440\u0442\u043d\u044b\u0439 Roblox jump;\n- \u043b\u0438\u0448\u043d\u0438\u0435 \u0434\u0432\u0438\u0436\u0435\u043d\u0438\u044f \u043a\u0430\u043c\u0435\u0440\u044b.\n\n\u041f\u0440\u0438 \u044d\u0442\u043e\u043c \u043a\u0430\u043c\u0435\u0440\u0430 \u0434\u043e\u043b\u0436\u043d\u0430 \u0431\u0440\u0430\u0442\u044c \u0434\u0432\u0438\u0436\u0435\u043d\u0438\u0435 \u0433\u043e\u043b\u043e\u0432\u044b \u0438\u043c\u0435\u043d\u043d\u043e \u0438\u0437 \u0430\u043d\u0438\u043c\u0430\u0446\u0438\u0439.\n\n==================================================\n27. HORROR CAMERA EFFECTS\n==================================================\n\n\u0414\u043e\u0431\u0430\u0432\u0438\u0442\u044c \u043f\u043e\u0434\u0434\u0435\u0440\u0436\u043a\u0443:\n\n- VHS noise;\n- \u043b\u0451\u0433\u043a\u0438\u0439 film grain;\n- breathing effect;\n- panic effect;\n- monster proximity effect.\n\n\u0412\u0441\u0435 \u044d\u0444\u0444\u0435\u043a\u0442\u044b \u0434\u043e\u043b\u0436\u043d\u044b \u0432\u043a\u043b\u044e\u0447\u0430\u0442\u044c\u0441\u044f \u0447\u0435\u0440\u0435\u0437 \u043e\u0442\u0434\u0435\u043b\u044c\u043d\u044b\u0439:\n\nCameraEffectsModule\n\n\u041d\u0430\u043f\u0440\u0438\u043c\u0435\u0440:\n\nMonster \u0440\u044f\u0434\u043e\u043c:\n\u2192 \u043a\u0430\u043c\u0435\u0440\u0430 \u043d\u0430\u0447\u0438\u043d\u0430\u0435\u0442 \u0441\u043b\u0435\u0433\u043a\u0430 \u0434\u0440\u043e\u0436\u0430\u0442\u044c.\n\nJumpscare:\n\u2192 \u0440\u0435\u0437\u043a\u043e\u0435 \u0434\u0432\u0438\u0436\u0435\u043d\u0438\u0435 \u043a\u0430\u043c\u0435\u0440\u044b.\n\n\u0421\u0442\u0440\u0430\u0445:\n\u2192 \u0438\u0437\u043c\u0435\u043d\u0435\u043d\u0438\u0435 FOV.\n\n==================================================\n28. DEVELOPMENT QUALITY\n==================================================\n\n\u041f\u0435\u0440\u0435\u0434 \u0441\u043e\u0437\u0434\u0430\u043d\u0438\u0435\u043c \u0441\u0438\u0441\u0442\u0435\u043c:\n\n\u043f\u0440\u043e\u0430\u043d\u0430\u043b\u0438\u0437\u0438\u0440\u0443\u0439 \u0442\u0435\u043a\u0443\u0449\u0438\u0439 .rbxl "json_block": "{\"language\": \"bash\", \"code\": \"cd /home/claude/chance/SSS/Systems && cat > MonsterController.lua <<'EOF'\\n--!nonstrict\\n--[[ CHANCE \\u00b7 MonsterController \\u2014 \\u0444\\u0443\\u043d\\u0434\\u0430\\u043c\\u0435\\u043d\\u0442 \\u0441\\u0443\\u0449\\u043d\\u043e\\u0441\\u0442\\u0438 (\\u043c\\u043e\\u0434\\u0435\\u043b\\u0438 \\u043d\\u0435\\u0442: \\u043d\\u0435\\u0432\\u0438\\u0434\\u0438\\u043c\\u044b\\u0439 MonsterRoot \\u0432 Workspace.Monster).\\n\\t\\u0421\\u0435\\u0440\\u0432\\u0435\\u0440 \\u0445\\u0440\\u0430\\u043d\\u0438\\u0442 \\u0441\\u043e\\u0441\\u0442\\u043e\\u044f\\u043d\\u0438\\u0435/\\u043f\\u043e\\u0437\\u0438\\u0446\\u0438\\u044e; \\u043a\\u043b\\u0438\\u0435\\u043d\\u0442 (MonsterFX) \\u0441\\u0447\\u0438\\u0442\\u0430\\u0435\\u0442 \\u0440\\u0430\\u0441\\u0441\\u0442\\u043e\\u044f\\u043d\\u0438\\u0435, \\u044d\\u0444\\u0444\\u0435\\u043a\\u0442\\u044b \\u0438 \\u0437\\u0432\\u0443\\u043a \\u0434\\u043b\\u044f \\u043a\\u0430\\u0436\\u0434\\u043e\\u0433\\u043e \\u0438\\u0433\\u0440\\u043e\\u043a\\u0430.\\n\\t\\u041f\\u043e\\u0437\\u0436\\u0435: MonsterController:SetModel(model) \\u2014 \\u043c\\u043e\\u0434\\u0435\\u043b\\u044c \\u0441 PrimaryPart \\u0437\\u0430\\u0439\\u043c\\u0451\\u0442 \\u043c\\u0435\\u0441\\u0442\\u043e MonsterRoot.\\n\\t\\u0421\\u0442\\u0430\\u0434\\u0438\\u0438: 0 \\u0434\\u0440\\u0435\\u043c\\u043b\\u0435\\u0442 \\u00b7 1 \\u0434\\u0430\\u043b\\u044c\\u043d\\u0438\\u0435 \\u043f\\u043e\\u044f\\u0432\\u043b\\u0435\\u043d\\u0438\\u044f \\u00b7 2 \\u0441\\u0440\\u0435\\u0434\\u043d\\u044f\\u044f \\u00b7 3 \\u0430\\u043a\\u0442\\u0438\\u0432\\u043d\\u0430\\u044f \\u043e\\u0445\\u043e\\u0442\\u0430. \\u041c\\u0435\\u043d\\u044f\\u0435\\u0442\\u0441\\u044f live: workspace:SetAttribute(\\\"MonsterStage\\\", n). ]]\\nlocal Players = game:GetService(\\\"Players\\\")\\nlocal PathfindingService = game:GetService(\\\"PathfindingService\\\")\\nlocal RunService = game:GetService(\\\"RunService\\\")\\nlocal CS = game:GetService(\\\"CollectionService\\\")\\nlocal RS = game:GetService(\\\"ReplicatedStorage\\\")\\nlocal Config = require(RS.Configs.GameConfig)\\nlocal Util = require(RS.Modules.Util)\\nlocal Remotes = require(RS.Modules.Remotes)\\n\\nlocal M = {}\\nM.__index = M\\n\\nlocal PARK = Vector3.new(0, -400, 0)\\n\\nfunction M.new(ctx) return setmetatable({ ctx = ctx, state = \\\"Dormant\\\", stage = 0 }, M) end\\n\\nfunction M:Start()\\n\\tself.remote = Remotes.get(\\\"Monster\\\")\\n\\tlocal folder = Util.folder(workspace, \\\"Monster\\\")\\n\\tlocal root = folder:FindFirstChild(\\\"MonsterRoot\\\")\\n\\tif not root then\\n\\t\\troot = Instance.new(\\\"Part\\\")\\n\\t\\troot.Name = \\\"MonsterRoot\\\"; root.Size = Vector3.new(2.2, 6.4, 1.6)\\n\\t\\troot.Anchored = true; root.CanCollide = false; root.CanQuery = false; root.CanTouch = false\\n\\t\\troot.Transparency = Config.Monster.DebugShape and 0.15 or 1\\n\\t\\troot.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0); root.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic\\n\\t\\troot.CFrame = CFrame.new(PARK)\\n\\t\\troot.Parent = folder\\n\\tend\\n\\tself.root = root\\n\\tself:_setState(\\\"Dormant\\\")\\n\\tself.stage = workspace:GetAttribute(\\\"MonsterStage\\\") or Config.Monster.Stage\\n\\tworkspace:GetAttributeChangedSignal(\\\"MonsterStage\\\"):Connect(function() self:SetStage(workspace:GetAttribute(\\\"MonsterStage\\\")) end)\\n\\tRunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt) self:_update(dt) end)\\nend\\n\\nfunction M:_setState(s)\\n\\tself.state = s\\n\\tself.root:SetAttribute(\\\"State\\\", s)\\n\\tself.root:SetAttribute(\\\"Active\\\", s ~= \\\"Dormant\\\")\\n\\tself.remote:FireAllClients({ Op = \\\"state\\\", State = s })\\nend\\n\\nfunction M:IsActive() return self.state ~= \\\"Dormant\\\" end\\nfunction M:GetStage() return self.stage end\\nfunction M:GetPosition() return self.root.Position end\\n\\nfunction M:SetModel(model) -- \\u0431\\u0443\\u0434\\u0443\\u0449\\u0430\\u044f \\u043f\\u043e\\u0434\\u043c\\u0435\\u043d\\u0430 \\u043c\\u043e\\u0434\\u0435\\u043b\\u0438\\n\\tassert(model.PrimaryPart, \\\"Monster model needs a PrimaryPart\\\")\\n\\tself.model = model\\n\\tself.root.Transparency = 1\\nend\\n\\nfunction M:_place(cf)\\n\\tif self.model then self.model:PivotTo(cf) end\\n\\tself.root.CFrame = cf\\nend\\n\\nfunction M:DistanceTo(player)\\n\\tlocal char = Util.character(player)\\n\\tif not char or not self:IsActive() then return math.huge end\\n\\treturn (char.HumanoidRootPart.Position - self.root.Position).Magnitude / Config.Proximity.StudsPerMeter\\nend\\n\\nfunction M:SetStage(n)\\n\\tn = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(n) or 0), 0, 3)\\n\\tself.stage = n\\n\\tif n < 3 and (self.state == \\\"Hunt\\\" or self.state == \\\"Search\\\") then self:Disappear() end\\n\\tif n == 3 then\\n\\t\\ttask.delay(4, function()\\n\\t\\t\\tif self.stage == 3 and not self:IsActive() then\\n\\t\\t\\t\\tfor _, p in Players:GetPlayers() do\\n\\t\\t\\t\\t\\tif p:GetAttribute(\\\"Awake\\\") then self:StartHunt(p); break end\\n\\t\\t\\t\\tend\\n\\t\\t\\tend\\n\\t\\tend)\\n\\tend\\n\\tself.remote:FireAllClients({ Op = \\\"stage\\\", Stage = n })\\nend\\n\\n-- \\u041f\\u043e\\u044f\\u0432\\u043b\\u0435\\u043d\\u0438\\u0435: pos (Vector3), lookAt (Vector3?), lifetime (\\u0441\\u0435\\u043a, \\u0437\\u0430\\u0442\\u0435\\u043c \\u0438\\u0441\\u0447\\u0435\\u0437\\u0430\\u0435\\u0442), kind \\u2014 \\u043f\\u043e\\u0434\\u0441\\u043a\\u0430\\u0437\\u043a\\u0430 \\u043a\\u043b\\u0438\\u0435\\u043d\\u0442\\u0443 (\\\"silhouette\\\"/\\\"forest\\\"/\\u2026)\\nfunction M:Appear(pos, lookAt, lifetime, kind)\\n\\tif self.state == \\\"Hunt\\\" or self.state == \\\"Scare\\\" then return end\\n\\tself:_place(CFrame.lookAt(pos, lookAt and Vector3.new(lookAt.X, pos.Y, lookAt.Z) or pos + Vector3.zAxis))\\n\\tself:_setState(\\\"Watch\\\")\\n\\tself.remote:FireAllClients({ Op = \\\"appear\\\", Pos = pos, Kind = kind })\\n\\tif lifetime then\\n\\t\\tlocal token = {}\\n\\t\\tself.appearToken = token\\n\\t\\ttask.delay(lifetime, function()\\n\\t\\t\\tif self.appearToken == token and self.state == \\\"Watch\\\" then self:Disappear() end\\n\\t\\tend)\\n\\tend\\nend\\n\\nfunction M:Disappear()\\n\\tself.path, self.target, self.waypoints = nil, nil, nil\\n\\tself.appearToken = nil\\n\\tself:_place(CFrame.new(PARK))\\n\\tself:_setState(\\\"Dormant\\\")\\n\\tself.remote:FireAllClients({ Op = \\\"disappear\\\" })\\nend\\n\\n-- \\u0417\\u0432\\u0443\\u043a\\u043e\\u0432\\u0430\\u044f \\u0440\\u0435\\u043f\\u043b\\u0438\\u043a\\u0430. \\u041a\\u043b\\u0438\\u0435\\u043d\\u0442 \\u0441\\u0430\\u043c \\u0432\\u044b\\u0447\\u0438\\u0441\\u043b\\u044f\\u0435\\u0442 \\u0433\\u0440\\u043e\\u043c\\u043a\\u043e\\u0441\\u0442\\u044c \\u043f\\u043e \\u0440\\u0430\\u0441\\u0441\\u0442\\u043e\\u044f\\u043d\\u0438\\u044e \\u0434\\u043e \\u0438\\u0433\\u0440\\u043e\\u043a\\u0430.\\nfunction M:Cue(name, pos, volumeScale)\\n\\tself.remote:FireAllClients({ Op = \\\"cue\\\", Name = name, Pos = pos or self.root.Position, Scale = volumeScale or 1 })\\nend\\n\\nfunction M:GroundAt(pos)\\n\\tlocal res = workspace:Raycast(pos + Vector3.new(0, 80, 0), Vector3.new(0, -200, 0))\\n\\treturn res and res.Position or pos\\nend\\n\\nfunction M:RandomPointAround(center, rMin, rMax)\\n\\tlocal a, r = math.random() * math.pi * 2, rMin + math.random() * (rMax - rMin)\\n\\treturn self:GroundAt(center + Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * r, 0, math.sin(a) * r)) + Vector3.new(0, self.root.Size.Y / 2, 0)\\nend\\n\\nfunction M:HouseCenter()\\n\\tlocal sum, n = Vector3.zero, 0\\n\\tfor _, d in CS:GetTagged(Config.Tags.Door) do sum += d:GetPivot().Position; n += 1 end\\n\\treturn n > 0 and sum / n or Vector3.zero\\nend\\n\\n-- \\u041e\\u0445\\u043e\\u0442\\u0430 ------------------------------------------------------------------\\nfunction M:StartHunt(player)\\n\\tlocal char = Util.character(player)\\n\\tif not char then return end\\n\\tlocal pos = self:RandomPointAround(char.HumanoidRootPart.Position, 55, 80)\\n\\tself:_place(CFrame.new(pos))\\n\\tself.target = player\\n\\tself.huntEnd = nil\\n\\tself.repath = 0\\n\\tself.stepClock = 0\\n\\tself:_setState(\\\"Hunt\\\")\\n\\tself.remote:FireAllClients({ Op = \\\"hunt\\\", Pos = pos })\\n\\tself:Cue(\\\"DistantScream\\\")\\nend\\n\\nfunction M:_moveAlong(dt, goal, speed)\\n\\tlocal pos = self.root.Position\\n\\tself.repath -= dt\\n\\tif self.repath <= 0 then\\n\\t\\tself.repath = 0.9\\n\\t\\tlocal path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({ AgentRadius = 2, AgentHeight = 6, AgentCanJump = false })\\n\\t\\tlocal ok = pcall(function() path:ComputeAsync(pos - Vector3.new(0, self.root.Size.Y / 2 - 1, 0), goal) end)\\n\\t\\tself.waypoints = ok and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success and path:GetWaypoints() or nil\\n\\t\\tself.wpIndex = 2\\n\\tend\\n\\tlocal nextPos = goal\\n\\tif self.waypoints and self.waypoints[self.wpIndex] then\\n\\t\\tnextPos = self.waypoints[self.wpIndex].Position\\n\\t\\tif (Util.flat(nextPos - pos)).Magnitude < 2 then self.wpIndex += 1 end\\n\\tend\\n\\tlocal dir = Util.flat(nextPos - pos)\\n\\tif dir.Magnitude > 0.05 then\\n\\t\\tlocal step = dir.Unit * speed * dt\\n\\t\\tlocal newPos = Vector3.new(pos.X + step.X, nextPos.Y + self.root.Size.Y / 2 - 1, pos.Z + step.Z)\\n\\t\\tself:_place(CFrame.lookAt(newPos, newPos + dir))\\n\\tend\\n\\tself.stepClock += dt\\n\\tif self.stepClock > (speed > 14 and 0.34 or 0.5) then\\n\\t\\tself.stepClock = 0\\n\\t\\tself:Cue(\\\"Footsteps\\\", nil, 1)\\n\\tend\\nend\\n\\nfunction M:_update(dt)\\n\\tif self.state == \\\"Hunt\\\" then\\n\\t\\tlocal p = self.target\\n\\t\\tlocal char = p and Util.character(p)\\n\\t\\tif not char then self:Disappear(); return end\\n\\t\\tlocal hide = self.ctx.HideSystem\\n\\t\\tif hide and hide:IsHidden(p) then\\n\\t\\t\\tself.searchSpot = hide:SpotOf(p)\\n\\t\\t\\tself.searchLeft = Config.Monster.SearchTime\\n\\t\\t\\tself:_setState(\\\"Search\\\")\\n\\t\\t\\tself:Cue(\\\"Screech\\\")\\n\\t\\t\\treturn\\n\\t\\tend\\n\\t\\tlocal d = (char.HumanoidRootPart.Position - self.root.Position).Magnitude\\n\\t\\tif d <= Config.Monster.KillDistance then self:Jumpscare(p); return end\\n\\t\\tself:_moveAlong(dt, char.HumanoidRootPart.Position, d > 35 and Config.Monster.RunSpeed or Config.Monster.WalkSpeed)\\n\\telseif self.state == \\\"Search\\\" then\\n\\t\\tlocal spot = self.searchSpot\\n\\t\\tlocal p = self.target\\n\\t\\tif not spot or not spot.Parent or not p then self:Disappear(); return end\\n\\t\\tlocal spotPos = Util.bounds(spot).Position\\n\\t\\tlocal d = (Util.flat(spotPos - self.root.Position)).Magnitude\\n\\t\\tif d > 7 then\\n\\t\\t\\tself:_moveAlong(dt, spotPos, Config.Monster.WalkSpeed * 0.7)\\n\\t\\telse\\n\\t\\t\\tself.searchLeft -= dt\\n\\t\\t\\tself.scratch = (self.scratch or 0) - dt\\n\\t\\t\\tif self.scratch <= 0 then self.scratch = 2.2 + math.random() * 2; self:Cue(math.random() < 0.5 and \\\"Scratch\\\" or \\\"Breath\\\") end\\n\\t\\t\\t-- \\u0448\\u0430\\u043d\\u0441 \\\"\\u0437\\u0430\\u0433\\u043b\\u044f\\u043d\\u0443\\u0442\\u044c\\\": \\u0440\\u0430\\u0441\\u0442\\u0451\\u0442 \\u043a \\u043a\\u043e\\u043d\\u0446\\u0443 \\u043f\\u043e\\u0438\\u0441\\u043a\\u0430, \\u043d\\u043e \\u043d\\u0438\\u043a\\u043e\\u0433\\u0434\\u0430 \\u043d\\u0435 \\u043c\\u0433\\u043d\\u043e\\u0432\\u0435\\u043d\\u043d\\u044b\\u0439\\n\\t\\t\\tif self.searchLeft < Config.Monster.SearchTime * 0.4 and math.random() < 0.06 * dt * 6 then\\n\\t\\t\\t\\tif self.ctx.HideSystem:IsHidden(p) and math.random() < 0.25 then self:Jumpscare(p); return end\\n\\t\\t\\tend\\n\\t\\t\\tif self.searchLeft <= 0 then self:Cue(\\\"DistortedVoice\\\"); self:Disappear() end\\n\\t\\tend\\n\\tend\\nend\\n\\nfunction M:Jumpscare(player)\\n\\tif self.state == \\\"Scare\\\" then return end\\n\\tself:_setState(\\\"Scare\\\")\\n\\tself.remote:FireClient(player, { Op = \\\"jumpscare\\\" })\\n\\tself:Cue(\\\"Screech\\\")\\n\\ttask.delay(3.4, function()\\n\\t\\tlocal hide = self.ctx.HideSystem\\n\\t\\tif hide then hide:Release(player) end\\n\\t\\tlocal char = Util.character(player)\\n\\t\\tlocal spawn = workspace:FindFirstChild(Config.Names.WakeSpawn)\\n\\t\\tif char and spawn then char:PivotTo(spawn.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)) 0.15 then\n\t\t\t\t\tself:_look(st.Position.X * 0.045, -st.Position.Y * 0.03)\n\t\t\t\tend\n\t\t\tend\n\t\tend\n\telseif locked then\n\t\tUIS.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default\n\t\tUIS.MouseIconEnabled = true\n\tend\n\n\t-- \u0442\u0435\u043b\u043e \u0441\u043b\u0435\u0434\u0443\u0435\u0442 \u0432\u0437\u0433\u043b\u044f\u0434\u0443 (\u0442\u043e\u043b\u044c\u043a\u043e \u0435\u0441\u043b\u0438 \u043d\u0438\u043a\u0442\u043e \u0434\u0440\u0443\u0433\u043e\u0439 \u043d\u0435 \u0434\u0435\u0440\u0436\u0438\u0442 \u043f\u0435\u0440\u0441\u043e\u043d\u0430\u0436\u0430)\n\tif self.enabled and not root.Anchored then\n\t\troot.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, self.yaw, 0)\n\tend\n\n\t-- \u0441\u043a\u043e\u0440\u043e\u0441\u0442\u044c / \u043f\u043e\u0445\u043e\u0434\u043a\u0430 / \u0438\u043d\u0435\u0440\u0446\u0438\u044f\n\tlocal v = Util.flat(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity)\n\tself.vel = self.vel:Lerp(v, math.min(1, dt * 12))\n\tlocal accel = (self.vel - self.prevVel) / math.max(dt, 1 / 240)\n\tself.prevVel = self.vel\n\tlocal la = root.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(accel)\n\tlocal grounded = hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air\n\tlocal speed = self.vel.Magnitude\n\tlocal running = speed > Config.Player.RunSpeed * 0.8\n\tlocal targetAmp = (grounded and speed > 0.8) and (running and cfg.BobRun or cfg.BobWalk) or 0\n\tself.bobAmp = Util.damp(self.bobAmp, targetAmp, 9, dt)\n\tself.bobPhase += dt * speed * cfg.BobFrequency * 0.55\n\tlocal bobY = math.sin(self.bobPhase * 2) * self.bobAmp\n\tlocal bobX = math.cos(self.bobPhase) * self.bobAmp * 0.55\n\tlocal bobRoll = math.sin(self.bobPhase) * self.bobAmp * 0.1\n\n\tlocal kickTarget = -math.clamp(la.Z * cfg.Inertia, -cfg.InertiaMax * 0.5, cfg.InertiaMax)\n\tself.kickPitch = Util.damp(self.kickPitch, kickTarget, 8, dt)\n\tself.kickRoll = Util.damp(self.kickRoll, math.clamp(-la.X * cfg.Inertia * 0.25, -0.06, 0.06), 8, dt)\n\n\t-- \u0432\u0440\u0430\u0449\u0435\u043d\u0438\u0435 \u0433\u043e\u043b\u043e\u0432\u044b/\u0442\u043e\u0440\u0441\u0430 \u0438\u0437 \u0410\u041d\u0418\u041c\u0410\u0426\u0418\u0419 (\u0448\u0435\u044f, \u043d\u0430\u043a\u043b\u043e\u043d \u043a\u043e\u0440\u043f\u0443\u0441\u0430)\n\tlocal headRel = root.CFrame.Rotation:Inverse() * head.CFrame.Rotation\n\tlocal follow = CFrame.identity:Lerp(headRel, cfg.HeadFollow)\n\tlocal eye = (head.CFrame * cfg.Eye).Position\n\n\tlocal rot = CFrame.Angles(0, self.yaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(self.pitch + self.kickPitch, 0, 0) * follow * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, bobRoll + self.kickRoll)\n\tlocal yawCF = CFrame.Angles(0, self.yaw, 0)\n\tlocal pos = eye + yawCF * Vector3.new(bobX, bobY, 0)\n\tlocal base = CFrame.new(pos) * rot * self.fx:GetCameraOffset()\n\n\tlocal cf = base\n\tlocal blend = self.blend.Value\n\tif blend > 0.0005 then cf = base:Lerp(self.overrideCF.Value, blend) end\n\tcam.CFrame = cf\n\n\tlocal runKick = running and cfg.RunFOVKick or 0\n\tself.fovExtra = Util.damp(self.fovExtra, runKick, 4, dt)\n\tcam.FieldOfView = self.fovBase + self.fovExtra + self.fx.fovDelta\nend\n\nreturn C\nEOF\necho ok", "description": "\u0421\u043e\u0437\u0434\u0430\u0442\u044c CameraEffectsModule \u0438 CameraController"}, "message": \\u041a\\u0430\\u043c\\u0435\\u0440\\u0430 \\u0431\\u0435\\u0440\\u0451\\u0442 \\u0441\\u043c\\u0435\\u0449\\u0435\\u043d\\u0438\\u0435 \\u0447\\u0435\\u0440\\u0435\\u0437 Fx:GetCameraOffset(dt). ]]\\nlocal Lighting = game:GetService(\\\"Lighting\\\")\\nlocal RS = game:GetService(\\\"ReplicatedStorage\\\")\\nlocal Config = require(RS.Configs.GameConfig)\\n\\nlocal Fx = {}\\nFx.__index = Fx\\n\\nlocal MAXED = { vhs = true, grain = true, vignette = true, desat = true, blur = true, breath = true, pulse = true, pulseRate = true }\\nlocal KEYS = { \\\"vhs\\\", \\\"grain\\\", \\\"vignette\\\", \\\"desat\\\", \\\"blur\\\", \\\"shake\\\", \\\"fov\\\", \\\"breath\\\", \\\"pulse\\\", \\\"pulseRate\\\" }\\n\\nfunction Fx.new(overlay)\\n\\tlocal self = setmetatable({ overlay = overlay, layers = {}, t = 0, fovDelta = 0, jumpscareT = 0 }, Fx)\\n\\tself.cc = Lighting:FindFirstChild(\\\"ChanceCC\\\") or Instance.new(\\\"ColorCorrectionEffect\\\")\\n\\tself.cc.Name = \\\"ChanceCC\\\"; self.cc.Parent = Lighting\\n\\tself.blur = Lighting:FindFirstChild(\\\"ChanceBlur\\\") or Instance.new(\\\"BlurEffect\\\")\\n\\tself.blur.Name = \\\"ChanceBlur\\\"; self.blur.Size = 0.01)\\n\\treturn self\\nend\\n\\nfunction Fx:SetLayer(name, values, fade)\\n\\tlocal l = self.layers[name]\\n\\tif not l then\\n\\t\\tl = { cur = {}, target = {}, rate = 1 }\\n\\t\\tself.layers[name] = l\\n\\tend\\n\\tl.rate = 1 / math.max(fade or 0.6, 0.01)\\n\\tfor _, k in KEYS do l.target[k] = values[k] or 0 end\\n\\tl.dying = nil\\nend\\n\\nfunction Fx:ClearLayer(name, fade)\\n\\tlocal l = self.layers[name]\\n\\tif not l then return end\\n\\tfor _, k in KEYS do l.target[k] = 0 end\\n\\tl.rate = 1 / math.max(fade or 0.6, 0.01)\\n\\tl.dying = true\\nend\\n\\nfunction Fx:Pulse(name, values, seconds)\\n\\tself:SetLayer(name, values, 0.05)\\n\\ttask.delay(seconds, function() self:ClearLayer(name, 0.5) end)\\nend\\n\\nfunction Fx:Glitch(duration, intensity) self.overlay:Glitch(duration, intensity) end\\n\\n-- \\u0420\\u0435\\u0437\\u043a\\u0438\\u0439 \\u0438\\u0441\\u043f\\u0443\\u0433: \\u0432\\u0441\\u043f\\u044b\\u0448\\u043a\\u0430 + \\u0440\\u044b\\u0432\\u043e\\u043a FOV + \\u0441\\u0438\\u043b\\u044c\\u043d\\u0430\\u044f \\u0442\\u0440\\u044f\\u0441\\u043a\\u0430, \\u0437\\u0430\\u0442\\u0435\\u043c \\u0437\\u0430\\u0442\\u0443\\u0445\\u0430\\u043d\\u0438\\u0435\\nfunction Fx:Jumpscare()\\n\\tself.overlay:Flash(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.5, 1)\\n\\tself.overlay:Glitch(1.6, 1)\\n\\tself:Pulse(\\\"jumpscare\\\", { shake = 1, fov = -16, vhs = 1, grain = 1, vignette = 1, blur = 6 }, 0.9)\\n\\tself.jumpKick = 1\\nend\\n\\nfunction Fx:Update(dt)\\n\\tself.t += dt\\n\\tlocal out = {}\\n\\tfor _, k in KEYS do out[k] = 0 end\\n\\tfor name, l in self.layers do\\n\\t\\tfor _, k in KEYS do\\n\\t\\t\\tlocal c = l.cur[k] or 0\\n\\t\\t\\tc += (l.target[k] - c) * math.min(1, l.rate * dt * 3)\\n\\t\\t\\tl.cur[k] = c\\n\\t\\t\\tif MAXED[k] then out[k] = math.max(out[k], c) else out[k] += c end\\n\\t\\tend\\n\\t\\tif l.dying then\\n\\t\\t\\tlocal alive = false\\n\\t\\t\\tfor _, k in KEYS do if math.abs(l.cur[k]) > 0.002 then alive = true break end end\\n\\t\\t\\tif not alive then self.layers[name] = nil end\\n\\t\\tend\\n\\tend\\n\\tlocal o = self.overlay\\n\\to.vhs, o.grain, o.vignette = math.clamp(out.vhs, 0, 1), math.clamp(out.grain, 0, 1), math.clamp(out.vignette, 0, 1)\\n\\tself.cc.Saturation = -math.clamp(out.desat, 0, 1) * 0.9\\n\\tself.cc.Contrast = 0.08 + 0.7)\\n\\tself.blur.Size = math.clamp(out.blur, 0, 24)\\n\\tself.out = out\\n\\n\\t-- \\u0441\\u0435\\u0440\\u0434\\u0446\\u0435\\u0431\\u0438\\u0435\\u043d\\u0438\\u0435 \\u2192 FOV\\n\\tlocal beat = 0\\n\\tif out.pulse > 0.01 then\\n\\t\\tlocal x = (self.t * out.pulseRate) % 1\\n\\t\\tbeat = (math.exp(-x * 9) + 0.6 * math.exp(-math.abs(x - 0.18) * 14)) * out.pulse\\n\\tend\\n\\tself.fovDelta = out.fov - beat * 3.2\\nend\\n\\nlocal function n(seed, t) return math.noise(seed * 13.37, t, 0.5) * 2 end\\n\\n-- CFrame-\\u0441\\u043c\\u0435\\u0449\\u0435\\u043d\\u0438\\u0435 \\u043a\\u0430\\u043c\\u0435\\u0440\\u044b (\\u0442\\u0440\\u044f\\u0441\\u043a\\u0430 + \\u0434\\u044b\\u0445\\u0430\\u043d\\u0438\\u0435)\\nfunction Fx:GetCameraOffset()\\n\\tlocal o = self.out\\n\\tif not o then return CFrame.identity end\\n\\tlocal t = self.t\\n\\tlocal s = math.clamp(o.shake, 0, 2.5)\\n\\tlocal f = 1.4 + s * 9\\n\\tlocal jitter = Vector3.new(n(1, t * f), n(2, t *
